body:
Hi.  I wanted to chime in on this because I ran into it today.

**In a nutshell...**
On **iOS only**, when sharing to the Google Inbox app, the `message:` method is incorrectly set as the email subject instead of `title:` method.

It behaves as expected on Android.
@janicduplessis, it would probably be good to change the issue label.
Yep, this is an iOS issue. This may have been fixed by [dfeec4f](https://github.com/facebook/react-native/commit/eca331937e841944f44ba22c9ccdc4312dfeec4f)

Tested on 0.51, the recently added `subject`option does not seem to help. This is really frustrating. Are there any plans to fix it? Is there any way we can help? And again, it should be labelled as an iOS issue.

issue.title: [0.44] share on iOS does not utilize title
